sources.title: Housing and economic land availability assessment
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: National HELAA guidance requires assessment of suitable, available and achievable land and explicitly treats the assessment as evidence rather than an allocation or planning permission.

sources.title: Local plan Dataset
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data's local-plan dataset records current, emerging and historical plans and can help identify plan status; dataset status alone does not establish a site's allocation.

sources.title: Local plan boundary Dataset
sources.verified_claim: The local-plan-boundary dataset identifies the area a plan covers; exact boundary overlap establishes plan-area context only, not site allocation or deliverability.

sources.title: Emerging plans / call for sites / HELAA
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states HELAA is a technical assessment and that site inclusion does not mean allocation or permission; suitability, availability and achievability require technical appraisal.

sources.title: Enfield evidence base
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's official evidence base links HELAA material and site outcomes used to quantify potential land supply; individual candidate linkage still requires the exact HELAA/site identifier and geometry.

sources.title: Havering Local Plan update
sources.verified_claim: Havering reports that its adopted 2021 Local Plan is under update and current work is at evidence-review/collection stage; borough-wide plan status does not identify an individual candidate site.

sources.title: Site Allocations Development Plan Document
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's SADPD contains site-specific policies for 13 proposed allocations and had received the Inspector's report; only exact match to one of those defined sites can establish candidate allocation context.

sources.title: Call for Sites
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's 2026 Call for Sites sought potentially available land for the new Local Plan and states submissions are assessed for possible allocations; submission or call status is not allocation or permission.
